title: Variable Aerodynamic Damping Actuation via Co-Contraction: A Structural Analogy with Variable Stiffness Actuation
summary: This work identifies a passive aerodynamic damping effect induced by co-contraction in antagonistic redundant propulsion. Complementing prior work on aerodynamic promptness, which addressed active wrench-rate authority along constant-wrench fibers, we study the passive side: the local derivative of aerodynamic force with respect to air-relative velocity at a trim. This derivative defines an incremental aerodynamic damping coefficient.
